title: BadUSB - On Accessories that Turn Evil by Karsten Nohl + Jakob Lell
summary: Karsten Nohl and Jakob Lell present BadUSB at Black Hat 2014, showing that USB controller firmware can be reprogrammed to impersonate other device types. They demonstrate system compromise and a self-replicating USB threat that current defenses cannot detect.
why: HN uses it as the standard reference for why USB devices are dangerous beyond ordinary viruses.

quote.text: For anyone interested in the subject I recommend watching the presentation
